Self-service kits you can download and run. Each links to its full guide; verify
the SHA-256 before running, and keep input and output inside your authorization
boundary.

::: {.callout-important}
Several kits ingest or produce assessment data — a map of where your tenant is
weak. Treat that data as **Controlled**: keep it in-boundary, share only with
authorized personnel, and do not publish raw findings. Remediation guidance is
**advisory** — apply changes only through your normal change-control process.
:::

## Assessment & analysis

### Zero Trust Assessment Dashboard

Turns a Microsoft `ZeroTrustAssessmentReport.html` (or `.json`) into a
severity-scored, remediation-prioritized **Excel dashboard** (charts + pillar ×
risk heatmap) and a **Power BI-ready CSV**.
[Guide →](../customer-documents/operational-guides/zero-trust-assessment/index.qmd)

| Download | Prerequisites | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| [`Invoke-ZtDashboard.ps1`](../customer-documents/operational-guides/zero-trust-assessment/scripts/Invoke-ZtDashboard.ps1) | PowerShell 7+, Python 3.11+, UIAO toolkit (`pip install uiao`) | `f30811fd01616e2960e12dd0e870a4d19cd52a7c5c79f0e3bcc592ca5d13d509` |

## Group Policy migration

### GPO Migration Triage

Classifies every GPO for migration to Intune (workstations) or Azure Arc
(servers), with side-by-side classification and per-setting sizing.
[Guide →](../customer-documents/substrate/platform-tooling/invoke-gpo-migration-triage.qmd)

| Download | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| [`Invoke-GpoMigrationTriage.ps1`](../customer-documents/substrate/platform-tooling/scripts/Invoke-GpoMigrationTriage.ps1) | `afe88fb798e41acd61c714341420551fb7e06d0c8f80d58d31f84e98080ba603` |

### GPO Obsolete Audit

Flags Group Policy settings that are obsolete, deprecated, or superseded on
modern Windows so they aren't carried forward into the target estate.
[Guide →](../customer-documents/substrate/platform-tooling/invoke-gpo-obsolete-audit.qmd)

| Download | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| [`Invoke-GpoObsoleteAudit.ps1`](../customer-documents/substrate/platform-tooling/scripts/Invoke-GpoObsoleteAudit.ps1) | `958010c1f2f13da203074df76b0cca5c04f6b308abceffc4e2ca95ef6245342f` |

## Operator workstation

### UIAO PowerShell Pack

A single offline-installer zip that brings an operator workstation from bare
Windows to fully tooled for UIAO work without internet access at install time —
the PowerShell 7 runtime, curated modules, git/GitHub CLI, and a SHA-256-verified
silent installer. The zip and its integrity hash are on the pack page.
[Guide & download →](../customer-documents/substrate/platform-tooling/powershell-pack.qmd)

## Verifying a download

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Invoke-ZtDashboard.ps1 -Algorithm SHA256
# compare the output to the SHA-256 listed above before running
```
